Expected local layout once the matching package is added:
  deps/SDL_mixer-1.2.12/include/SDL/SDL_mixer.h
  deps/SDL_mixer-1.2.12/lib/libSDL_mixer.dll.a

The Makefile already points to this directory. The SDL_mixer package archive was
not part of the uploaded files, so no substitute headers or libraries are included.
Use the 32-bit MSYS2 package, not an MSVC .lib or 64-bit build.
